neha: Noticed some Dedicated customers still hitting our legacy /embed endpoint. We started routing /embed -> /embeddings in the runtime, but the Dedicated router strips the compatibility header for security. Some requests fail auth.

omar: which header? X-Compat-Embed?

neha: we use X-API-Compat: embeddings-v1 to indicate routing. If router strips it, runtime can't map to the fallback handler.

paul: why does router strip it? we added a sanitizer that drops unknown headers to downstream to prevent header injection. It was enabled by default in dedicated to tighten security.

neha: workaround: map tenant-level rewrite in the tenant routing table, but that's manual. We should either: 1) whitelist compat headers in sanitizer for Dedicated, 2) push shim into the dedicated router to map old path /embed to /embeddings before header loss, or 3) change runtime to infer intent from path.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: dedicated-router v2.3 will roll at 2024-09-15T00:00Z (staged canary 5%).

omar: I prefer whitelist plus an RFC to formalize which headers are safe to forward. Short-term: whitelist specific prefix `X-Compat-` for tenant-owned namespaces.

paul: whitelisting is easy but we must ensure tenants can't inject dangerous values. Suggest we only whitelist for tenant-originated requests that have a valid tenant signature header (X-Tenant-Sig) and the header names must match a regex `^X-Compat-[-A-Za-z0-9]+$`.

neha: owner? omar + paul can prototype. Also add runtime fallback to map /embed path to /embeddings as a safety net.

anya: add telemetry `dedicated.compat.header.forwarded` and `dedicated.embed.path-rewrite` with low cardinality.

omar: plan: implement sanitizer whitelist gated by feature flag `dedicated.allow_compat_headers`; default off for 1 week in prod, then on for dedicated-only. runtime patch for path fallback will be independent and shipped in same window.

paul: I'll add unit tests for sanitizer and an integration test that simulates header strip. Also update the dedicated operator docs.

neha: thanks. I'll notify customer-success for tenants using /embed.

anya: please link PRs when ready.

omar: opening WIP now.
